Read the statement, followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II, and decide which explains the event/observation/information given in the statement.Statement:The percentage of people who opt for counselling services is higher in urban areas as compared to rural areas.Reasons:I. People living in urban areas have more psychological problems.II. Rural areas have fewer counselling centres.
options: Only I is a possible reason
Only II is a possible reason
Both I and II are possible reasons
Neither I nor II is a possible reason
